name: chop-logic-components
description: Reusable React components and hooks for Chop Logic project

paragraphs: Chop Logic Components follows Atomic Design principles with Fully Typed TypeScript components. All styling uses pure CSS with CSS variables (BEM naming convention with cl- prefix) for consistent theming across light and dark modes. Built for developer productivity with comprehensive Storybook documentation and accessibility-first approach.
